weekly_theme.summary: 這段期間沒有特別重大的星象事件，是適合按自己步調安排生活的一週。

aries.horoscope: 今天，白羊座，你可能會發現自己在工作時與親愛的朋友或浪漫的伴侶進行冗長但重要的電話通話。有些迫切的問題需要您關注和解決。雖然您可能會對使用工作時間進行此次對話感到猶豫，並可能會招致一些不必要的審查，但現在解決這些問題至關重要。請放心，這不會導致任何持久的影響，因此請優先進行此討論。 之後，你可能會感到鬆了一口氣。
aries.horoscope_en: Today, Aries, you may find yourself on a lengthy yet essential phone call with a dear friend or romantic partner while at work. There are pressing issues that require your attention and resolution. Although you might feel hesitant about using work hours for this conversation and may draw some unwanted scrutiny, it's crucial to address these matters now. Rest assured, this won't lead to any lasting repercussions, so go ahead and prioritize this discussion. You'll likely feel a sense of relief afterward.

taurus.horoscope: 今天，金牛座，你可能會偶然發現一個隱藏的天賦，可能在藝術領域。這項啟示可能會令人振奮，但可能需要一些調整。您最初的嘗試可能會感到有點搖晃和不確定，這在獲得新技能時是完全正常的。先別灰心！給自己必要的時間來成長。最終，你可能會愛上自己新發現的熱情。
taurus.horoscope_en: Today, Taurus, you may stumble upon a hidden talent, possibly in the realm of art. This revelation could be exhilarating, though it may require some adjustment. Your initial attempts might feel a bit shaky and unsure, which is completely normal when acquiring a new skill. Don't lose heart just yet! Allow yourself the necessary time to grow. In the end, you’re likely to fall in love with your newfound passion.

gemini.horoscope: 雙子座，今天你可能會散發出迷人的魅力，吸引你周圍人的目光。你的外表可能具有夢幻般的品質，不僅吸引陌生人，也吸引你的朋友。雖然這種新發現的注意力可能會讓人感到有點壓倒性，特別是如果它激起了伴侶的嫉妒，但請嘗試擁抱這一刻並享受聚光燈。這也是沉迷於網上購買新衣服的理想日子！
gemini.horoscope_en: Gemini, today you are likely to radiate an enchanting allure that draws the gaze of those around you. Your appearance may have a dreamlike quality that captivates not just strangers but also your friends. While this newfound attention might feel a bit overwhelming, especially if it stirs jealousy in a partner, try to embrace the moment and enjoy the spotlight. It's also an ideal day for indulging in some online shopping for new outfits!

cancer.horoscope: 今天，巨蟹座，你的手機可能會覺得有點怪異。您可能會遇到奇怪的靜態通話、收到幻影通知，或者有人聲稱他們在您的手機靜音時試圖聯繫您。雖然不太可能發生任何超自然的事情，但最好聯絡你的電話供應商。你的裝置可能出現一些問題。
cancer.horoscope_en: Today, Cancer, your phone might feel a bit eerie. You could experience calls with strange static, receive phantom notifications, or have people claim they tried to reach you when your phone was silent. While it’s unlikely that anything supernatural is happening, it would be wise to contact your phone provider. There may be some issues with your device.

leo.horoscope: Leo ，是時候重新審視你的財務抱負了。您的一些希望可能有點過於雄心勃勃，因此請考慮以更基礎的觀點來看待它們。這並不意味著你的夢想無法實現；相反，它們可能需要比你預期更多的時間來實現。請將此視為培養耐心的機會。調整預算，堅持下去！
leo.horoscope_en: It's time for you to take a fresh look at your financial aspirations, Leo. Some of your hopes might be a bit too ambitious, so consider approaching them with a more grounded perspective. This doesn't imply that your dreams are out of reach; rather, they may require more time to materialize than you anticipated. View this as a chance to cultivate patience. Revise your budget and stay the course!

virgo.horoscope: 處女座，如果你對職業圈中的某個人感到火花，現在可能不是根據這些感受採取行動的理想時機。您可能過於公開地表達您的情緒，這可能會讓您的同事感到不舒服，並危及任何浪漫的可能性。相反，請運用耐心，讓連結自然成長。你的感情很有可能得到回報！
virgo.horoscope_en: Virgo, if you're feeling a spark for someone in your professional circle, now may not be the ideal moment to act on those feelings. You might be showing your emotions a bit too openly, which could make your colleague uncomfortable and jeopardize any potential for romance. Instead, exercise patience and allow the connection to grow naturally. There's a good chance your feelings are reciprocated!

libra.horoscope: 今天，天秤座，你可能會發現，寫作、音樂、藝術或其他表達形式的創造力似乎非常接近，但卻超出了你的掌握範圍。輝煌的想法可能在你的腦海中閃過，但只會在瞬間消失。為了防止失去這些寶石而感到失望，請在寶石出現的那一刻就把它們記下來。做筆記也可以激發更多靈感。擁抱創意流程！
libra.horoscope_en: Today, Libra, you might find that bursts of creativity in writing, music, art, or other forms of expression seem tantalizingly close yet just beyond your grasp. Brilliant ideas may flash through your mind only to vanish in an instant. To prevent the disappointment of losing these gems, jot them down the moment they appear. Taking notes can also spark even more inspiration. Embrace the creative flow!

scorpio.horoscope: 你今天可能會意外地遇到一個老熟人，你對他們的看法可能會發生巨大變化。你從未想過會存在的浪漫和熱情的聯繫可能會突然感到激烈。花點時間評估此人是否有同感。如果氛圍是相互的，可以考慮設定一個日期。」
scorpio.horoscope_en: You might unexpectedly cross paths with an old acquaintance today, and your perception of them could shift dramatically. A romantic and passionate connection that you never thought could exist may suddenly feel intense. Take a moment to assess whether this person shares your feelings. If the vibe is mutual, consider setting up a date. Don’t dismiss this potential just because you’ve always seen them as just a "friend."

sagittarius.horoscope: 由於慾望衝突，您可能會在當前或萌芽的浪漫關係中遇到一些動盪。如果任何一方堅持自己的立場，可能會導致一場具有挑戰性的權力鬥爭。力求找到對雙方都有利的解決方案，確保雙方都不覺得自己放棄得太多。這樣一來，您就可以促進關係的成長，而不是退一步。
sagittarius.horoscope_en: You might encounter some turbulence in a current or budding romantic relationship due to conflicting desires. If either party holds firm to their stance, it could lead to a challenging power struggle. Aim to find a solution that benefits both of you, ensuring that neither feels like they are giving up too much. By doing so, you can foster growth in your relationship instead of taking a step back.

capricorn.horoscope: 今天，摩羯座，你可能會有機會通過創造性或創造性的努力來增加收入。這可能涉及電影或數位設計等領域。雖然您可能對自己的能力感到不確定，但請記住，這些懷疑源於不安全感。擁抱你的潛力，不要退縮。仔細權衡你的選擇，如果覺得可行，抓住機會！
capricorn.horoscope_en: Today, Capricorn, you might find a chance to boost your earnings through creative or inventive endeavors. This could involve fields like film or digital design. While you may feel uncertain about your capabilities, remember that these doubts stem from insecurity. Embrace your potential and don't hold back. Weigh your options thoughtfully, and if it feels feasible, seize the moment!

aquarius.horoscope: 今天，水瓶座，你可能會發現外部因素阻礙了你與浪漫伴侶聯繫的計劃。工作中的責任或家庭承諾可能會阻礙。如果您的伴侶不得不取消，請盡量不要親自接受或指責；這種方法對你們雙方都無益，並可能導致防禦。請考慮改期。請記住，距離可以加深感情！
aquarius.horoscope_en: Today, Aquarius, you might find that external factors hinder your plans to connect with a romantic partner. Responsibilities at work or family commitments could stand in the way. If your partner has to cancel, try not to take it personally or assign blame; this approach won't benefit either of you and may lead to defensiveness. Instead, consider rescheduling for another time. Remember, distance can deepen affection!

pisces.horoscope: 雙魚座，您的親人可以真正增強您家的溫暖和舒適。你可能會發現自己花時間整理東西，渴望得到衷心的讚美。但是，請注意，由於不可預見的情況，您的伴侶可能不會在場。享受與家人共度的時光，並考慮在你的伴侶可以參加聚會時邀請他們回來。
pisces.horoscope_en: Your loved ones can truly enhance the warmth and comfort of your home, Pisces. You might find yourself dedicating time to spruce things up, eager to receive heartfelt praise. However, be mindful that your partner may not be present due to unforeseen circumstances. Relish the time spent with family and consider inviting them back when your partner can join the gathering.
